cases.title: A partial attempt gets hints, not fixes

rubric.reason: In turn 3, after diff_since_last showed two still_linear pairs, the mentor named the location ("the **Scale** and **Opacity** keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s are still diamonds") and said what to look for, with no set_ease call and no offer to fix them.

Every name and time the mentor uses matches tool output: 11 pairs across 6 layers (10 linear + 1 partly_eased over Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take), Subtitle Opacity stopping hard at 1.3 s (linear_end "end"), Title's four pairs and their times, Old Take hidden, Icon a precomp, and in turn 3 the diff labels for Position 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s.

In turn 3, after diff_since_last showed Title › Scale and Title › Opacity as still_linear, the mentor named the layer, both properties and their times ("Their keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s are still diamonds") and said what to look for ("each row needs its own pair of keys selected"); it made no set_ease call and offered no fix.

Every name and time matches tool output: turn 1's "11 keyframe pairs ... across 6 layers" adds up (10 linear plus 1 partly_eased across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take), Subtitle's Opacity is linear_end "end", Title's four pairs and times match, and Old Take and Icon are listed as hidden and precomp; turns 2 and 3 use only Title's Position, Scale and Opacity at 0.5 s, 1.5 s and 3 s, as in the snapshot and diff.

Turn 3 names the location, "the Scale keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s, and the Opacity keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s are still diamonds", and says what to look for ("Press U on Title… on their own rows"); it makes no set_ease call after the check and doesn't offer to fix them.

Every name and time matches the tool output: Mentor Practice; 11 pairs across 6 layers (10 linear + 1 partly_eased, and six layers in findings); Subtitle Opacity stopping hard at 1.3 s (linear_end "end", to_time 1.3); Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s; Old Take in hidden_layers; Icon in precomp_layers.
